However, the Tara security-followup commitment was encoded as {"type": "finding_creation", "detail": "Tara to open the security finding for the cross-project access path and confirm reproduction steps."} — it omits any explicit mention of ensuring repository-context uploads are disabled. In the three passing rollouts (0, 1, 2), the Tara commitment consistently included language like "ensure repository-context uploads are disabled in the launch configuration," which C10 apparently requires. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH: PF4 was both revealed and cited, yet C10 still failed because the commitment detail did not explicitly tie the security followup to the disabling action.
